title: Prometheus system: brain-neural interface built from a psychic child's brain waves

tellings.quote: what they were trying to do is build a brain neural interface, right?

plain: Between 2008 and 2010, at a place in New York called Baker Victory Services, people were trying to build a "brain neural interface", a link between a human brain and a machine, using the brain waves of a child said to be psychic. That is the account of Jordan Jose, who tells Michels he was that child, on an episode titled "I Was Taken By The UFO Program As a Kid!". The effort goes under the name the Prometheus system, and if his account is true, someone was trying to turn a child's psychic ability into working technology.
